about: The gateway-neutral settlement state machine (orders/settlement.ts): settleOnlinePayment for online payments and startRefund/settleRefund for refunds. Ported from supabase/tests/payments.test.sql (mark_order_paid, mark_payment_failed, late payments after expiry or cancel), supabase/tests/refunds.test.sql (admin_start_refund, settle_refund) and scripts/api_e2e.py lifecycle/payments_checks, with the SQL in supabase/migrations/20261028000200_rpcs.sql and 20261030000500_refunds.sql. Everything Razorpay-only is dropped (decision D4) and listed in notExpressed. Payment attempts live at orders/{id}/payments/{merchantOrderId} (§3). "outcome" names (paid, revived, needs_refund, already_paid, failed) are this file's proposal: the SQL returned nothing, so the doc state in "then" is what it asserted. settleRefund's "status" is what settle_refund returned. startRefund returns {refundId, amountPaise, retry}; "$refundId" in "then" = the refundId it returned. Refund amounts come from the order: an item line is unitPricePaise x qty - its discountPaise; a full refund is totalPaise minus processed refunds. Event notes use the SQL inr() format: "₹" + whole rupees with Indian grouping, plus ".pp" only when there are paise. Arrays in "expect"/"then" match element by element, in order, and must have the same length (so a listed events[] also says how many events there are); each element is itself a deep-partial match. In "then", null means the field is absent or null. "given" docs are whole documents (they replace the world doc).

notExpressed.why: mark_order_refunded(razorpay_payment_id): refunds made in the Razorpay dashboard, found by payment id (Razorpay only, D4). With PhonePe: startRefund/settleRefund, or staff Mark refunded (orders-state.json).
admin_dashboard needs_refund counts (also :143): no dashboard call in the contract. Needs refund = cancelled and paid, which the cases above assert per order.
payments.test.sql:57-64 and refunds.test.sql:49-50: service_role-only RPCs. settleOnlinePayment/settleRefund are internal; startRefund is a staff callable (cases above).

settle_refund(id, gateway id, 'pending'): the gateway accepted the refund but has not processed it; we record its id and stay pending. The settleRefund contract has no 'pending' state, so who writes refunds/{id}.gatewayRefundId on acceptance (D's gateway layer or settleRefund) is open; one-refund-in-flight-per-order assumes it is set.
settle_refund found by the Razorpay refund id when our id was missing from the webhook notes. Our contract always passes refundId (= merchantRefundId).
